The DropletUtils package33,34 was used to remove empty droplets from the kallisto bustools gene count matrix. For Cell Ranger, the filtered matrix was used. After filtering, genes not detected in any remaining Cell Ranger or kallisto bustools barcode were removed. Seurat was used for basic analysis. First, data were normalized by dividing the UMI count of each gene in each cell by the total UMI counts of that cell, and the result was multiplied by 10,000. Subsequently, the normalized data were scaled so the distribution of the expression of each gene would have a mean of 0 and a standard deviation of 1. We also introduce a set of quality control metrics, and accompanying tool, for validating barcode designs.
